headline: A candidate asks for your vote for months. Then wields power for four years.
description: It's all recorded in public portals — fragmented, technical, hard to follow. Meu Candidato translates that record and cross-checks it with fact-checks.
quote: "We show the record. The conclusion is yours."
pointPledge: Pledges start at R$ 30, across 5 reward tiers
pointGoal: The goal funds the app's first working version
pointIndependence: No pledge grants influence over data or fact-checks
